principles: current-universe use is not automatically survivorship bias
a candidate requires manual call-path review before defect classification
historical sample membership must not be defined by current active universe membership
current metadata must not be silently treated as historical point-in-time truth
current latest scanner state must not define historical labels or sample eligibility
absence from the current universe is not historical OUT_OF_SCOPE evidence

known_safe_paths.src/scanner/reports/research_views.py: Historical scanner views are built from observed scanner rows and run groups; no current universe master is used to define historical membership.
known_safe_paths.src/scanner/research/query_api.py: History queries filter only explicit requested symbols and dates; no current universe master is loaded.
known_safe_paths.src/scanner/reports/daily_research.py: Latest scanner is the intended current target population for the daily report; history is queried for those current symbols and is not used as a retrospective universe-wide validation sample.
Cross-file integrity validation checks hashes, provenance, ranks and view derivation; it does not filter historical archive membership against a current universe.
known_safe_paths.scripts/audit_phase4_risk_scale.py: Diagnostic compares full historical stock metric distributions with the current snapshot to detect scale breaks; current symbols do not define the historical sample.
known_safe_paths.scripts/collect_external_evidence_8c_sec: Current scanner rows define prospective SEC acquisition targets; research history is used only to derive a document acquisition window, explicitly not feature/sample membership.
known_safe_paths.scripts/qm_b_alias_listing_boundaries.py: QM-B diagnostic intentionally compares preserved historical observations with current/historical identity sources; it does not create a productive historical research sample.
known_safe_paths.scripts/qm_b_crypto_identifier.py: QM-B identity diagnostic uses current master only as reference evidence and explicitly forbids current mappings from proving historical identity or membership.
known_safe_paths.scripts/qm_b_identity_reconciliation.py: QM-B identity reconciliation is an audit layer with fail-closed PIT rules, not a historical selection/performance sample builder.
known_safe_paths.scripts/qm_b_identity_repo_history.py: QM-B repository-history audit examines historical identity evidence against a frozen cutoff and does not define return-research membership from the current universe.
known_safe_paths.scripts/qm_b_observed_membership.py: QM-B staging preserves scanner-observed historical membership evidence and keeps current matches from becoming historical membership proof.
known_safe_paths.scripts/run_confidence_vnext_prospective: Latest scanner is used to issue prospective shadow claims; historical prices mature prior claims and do not retrospectively select historical members by current presence.
Phase 5B is a prospective claim/outcome stream plus frozen baseline; latest state is current claim input, not a filter defining the historical research universe.
Historical Phase 1-3 evidence is kept separate from current-state applicability; latest scanner is the current application target and does not filter the historical validation registry.
